_readme: Copy this file (e.g. to migrate-map.json, which is git-ignored), replace every <PLACEHOLDER>
with the names your Zabbix uses, and delete the generations you do not have. The script
refuses to run while a placeholder is left. Paths are relative to this file.
mode 'in-place': a template that already has the current name but whose items carry an older
key prefix. Keys are renamed on the template; every linked host follows with the same items.
mode 'replace': hosts linked to old_templates get new_templates. With unlink_old true the old
template is unlinked WITHOUT clear and its items stay on the host with their history; keys
that map onto a key of a new template are renamed first so the link adopts them.
keys / macros map exact names; key_prefixes / macro_prefixes map a leading prefix.

generations.name: old-cluster-template
generations._unlink_old: false: none of its metric keys exists in the ElasticPro templates, so nothing moves; the new templates are linked beside it. true retires it: its items stay on the host as host items, with their history, and the macros they use are copied to the host.

generations.name: old-cluster-template-to-jump-host
old_templates: <OLD ELASTICSEARCH CLUSTER TEMPLATE FOR A CLUSTER BEHIND A JUMP HOST>
new_templates: ElasticPro Elasticsearch via SSH jump host
generations._unlink_old: true: the jump host template uses the same es.cluster.* keys, so the link adopts those items and their history moves with them.
